summary: Enhance your skills with our Legal Audit and Regulatory Compliance Assessment Training. Gain essential knowledge to navigate complex regulations effectively.
lede: Regulatory compliance training helps legal counsel, compliance officers, and internal auditors assess whether obligations are reflected in operational controls. The course covers obligation mapping and risk prioritization, control testing and evidence evaluation, findings classification, and corrective-action tracking, using ISO 19011 audit guidance, ISO 37301 compliance principles, and COSO control concepts.
audienceIntro: This legal audit course suits professionals who already work with governance, contracts, compliance, risk, internal controls, or assurance and need a more disciplined assessment method.
modules: Legal Audit Integration and Action Planning
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of compliance, legal operations, internal audit, enterprise risk, contracts, or governance processes. You should be able to read policies, procedures, contracts, and basic control evidence. No coding or programming is required. Advanced concepts such as AI-assisted review, automated monitoring, and dashboard analytics are taught at operational application level rather than technical engineering level.
